# Shirone

> A Material 3 anime blog

This is the llms.txt file for Shirone. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://shirone.mysqil.com/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://shirone.mysqil.com/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://shirone.mysqil.com/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.

## Articles
- [Welcome to the Shirone Content Repo](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/guideen/): A sample post showing Shirone's typography and metadata configuration.
- [【考研篇|数据结构】绪论](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/data-structures-introduction/)
- [markdown公式写法大全](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/markdown/): ai 整理的 markdown 公式语法，放在这里方便速查。
- [[学习篇 | ctfshow] pwn入门-格式化字符串](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/pwn-beginner-formatted-strings/): CTFSHOW pwn刷题入门记录，格式化字符串。
- [[学习篇 | ctfshow] pwn入门-栈溢出](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/pwn-introduction-stack-overflow/): CTFSHOW pwn刷题入门记录，栈溢出。
- [[比赛篇 | SHCTF]第三届SHCTFWP](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/the-third-shctfwp/): 记录一下本次比赛中成功解出来的题目
- [[比赛篇 | CTF] 2025春秋杯冬季赛WP](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/2025-spring-and-autumn-cup-winter-season-wp/): 记录一下本次比赛中成功解出来的题目
- [【 比赛篇 | CTF 】2025CISCN暨长城杯](https://shirone.mysqil.com/posts/2025-cisc--and-great-wall-cup/): 记录一下本次比赛中成功解出来的题目

## Full Text Dump
- [Full Text Archive](https://shirone.mysqil.com/llms-full.txt): Complete, concatenated Markdown content of all public articles for full-context ingestion.
